noticeText:
JENKINS, (née Doyle), Maureen - (Clonshaugh and formerly of Harmonstown), Passed away Peacefully on October 7th 2019 in her 99th Year in the wonderful care of staff at Riverside Nursing Home, St. Margaret’s. beloved wife of the Late Bill and devoted mother to Peter, Ann, Geraldine, Monica, Mandy, Christine and the Late Gerard and Frances, dear sister of Patty and Veronica and her late brothers and sisters. Sadly missed by grandchildren, great-grandchildren, great-great-grandchild, sons-in-law, daughter-in-law, relatives and friends.
May She Rest in Peace
Reposing at Jennings Funeral Home, Oscar Traynor Rd, Coolock this Thursday afternoon, 10th October, from 4pm to 6pm. Removal on Friday morning to Our Lady of Mercy Church, Artane arriving for 10am Funeral Mass followed by burial in Old Balgriffin Cemetery, Malahide Road.
